d:
Governments award contracts, commission infrastructure projects and promise financial assistance. But what happens when the government itself fails to pay on time?
Maharashtra's Public Works Minister acknowledged that ₹17,000 crore in bills were pending with the department, of which ₹6,200 crore had been cleared. Across India, contractors, MSMEs and beneficiaries of government schemes are facing delays that can mean mounting loans, unpaid wages, stalled projects and families pushed into financial distress.
